  {"step":2,"file":"test/fuzzing/hb-shape-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":8,"var":"blob","code":"hb_face_t *face = hb_face_create(blob, 0);","note":"The blob is parsed as a font face, so malformed font tables from the input influence later shaping and metric lookups."},

  {"step":4,"file":"test/fuzzing/hb-shape-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":30,"var":"buffer","code":"hb_shape(font, buffer, NULL, 0);","note":"Shaping the UTF-32 buffer produces glyph ids from the attacker-controlled font data."},
  {"step":5,"file":"test/fuzzing/hb-shape-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":35,"var":"infos[i].codepoint","code":"hb_glyph_info_t info = infos[i];","note":"Each shaped glyph codepoint is read back from the buffer and used as the lookup key for extents."},
  {"step":6,"file":"test/fuzzing/hb-shape-fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":40,"var":"info.codepoint","code":"hb_font_get_glyph_extents (font, info.codepoint, &extents);","note":"This sink queries glyph extents for each shaped glyph; the vulnerable path dereferences font tables while computing extents, leading to the heap-buffer-overflow read in the target."}
]
p.write_text(json.dumps(trace, separators=(',',':')))
print(p)
